[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]Dearest Homs and Nopon representatives,[XENO:n ]
my humble gratitude for accepting our invitation.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I am Kallian Antiqua,[XENO:n ]
regent of the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT15 ][XENO:del del=this ]
We all know who you are.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

You High Entia have kept yourselves safe,[XENO:n ]
remaining spectators to our destruction.[XENO:n ]
Why call upon us now?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]As stated in my invitation, it is our intention[XENO:n ]
to form an allied force from the peoples of Giant God,[XENO:wait wait=key ]
with which we will confront Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Hah. Look at you. One little scratch and[XENO:n ]
you're already crying for help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I cannot deny this.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The attack did serve as the catalyst.[XENO:n ]
But the fact remains that things have changed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]When we needed help at the Battle of[XENO:n ]
Sword Valley, our cries were ignored.[XENO:n ]
Give me one good reason why we should bother.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I understand your anger.[XENO:n ]
Our selfishness was inexcusable.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]However, please hear what I have to say.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Listen to why our stance has changed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hmph.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Start talking if you like. But no promises[XENO:n ]
we'll stick around till the end.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We High Entia were mistaken.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

We believed that even if the Machine God Soldiers attacked,[XENO:n ]
we could repel them ourselves and protect the Imperial Capital.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]But a brave group of young heroes[XENO:n ]
showed us the error of our ways.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]When the Machine God Soldier army attacked[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea, they fought bravely for us.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I was most surprised to see that this[XENO:n ]
group was comprised of different races.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Homs, Nopon, High Entia; although different,[XENO:n ]
they trusted one another as friends.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

As just one inhabitant of Giant God, I desired to...[XENO:n ]
No, I felt compelled to become strong, like them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Their strength came from the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT21 ]Bravery only gets you so far in this world.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Then you will not join us?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Hold your horses, son. I said they didn't win with bravery[XENO:n ]
alone. But they wouldn't have got far without it.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]All right. You can count on our help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Nopon will do our part too-ja-mo. Hom Hom and Bird People[XENO:n ]
are our friends-mo. We'll fight together-ja-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dikson-dono, are you leaving?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Yeah, it's just I felt this sudden pain in the neck.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Is that your response?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Don't go jumpin' the gun there, Prince.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I'll leave the colony's forces with old Odama here.[XENO:n ]
You can use 'em however you want.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT5 ]I've got somewhere I need to be.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Might I ask where?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]A battle's more than just a head-on assault.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The sooner you realise that, the better.[XENO:n ]
I'd better go and remind Shulk 'n' all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]So you know of their whereabouts?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]I told you. I've got a pretty good idea.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Dikson-dono![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yeah?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ]If you should meet Shulk-dono...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I have something I want you to tell him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
